editorial.blurb: Chef Shoji's intimate omakase counter delivers Chicago's most spectacular sushi experience, with generous cuts, impeccable sequencing, and a chef who's genuinely passionate about every piece.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the omakase experience ahead of time rather than ordering à la carte—it's a better value and allows Chef Shoji to curate the perfect progression. The izakaya bar menu offers more affordable traditional Japanese options if you want to return without the omakase commitment.
